milestones.label: Application deadline (round 1 for 2027 entry)
milestones.source_text: Imperial College London's page for the President's PhD Scholarships (official) lists round 1 as closing on 2 November 2026 at 23:59 UK time.

milestones.label: Decisions for round 1
milestones.source_text: Imperial (official) says round 1 decisions are due by 31 January 2027.

milestones.label: Application deadline (round 2 for 2027 entry)
milestones.source_text: Imperial College London's page for the President's PhD Scholarships (official) lists round 2 as closing on 11 January 2027 at 23:59 UK time.

milestones.label: Decisions for round 2
milestones.source_text: Imperial (official) says round 2 decisions are due by 15 April 2027.

milestones.label: Application deadline (round 3 for 2027 entry)
milestones.source_text: Imperial College London's page for the President's PhD Scholarships (official) lists round 3 as closing on 1 March 2027 at 23:59 UK time.

milestones.label: Decisions for round 3
milestones.source_text: Imperial (official) says round 3 decisions are due by 31 May 2027.
